name: @maestro/api-client
description: Generated Maestro OpenAPI types and typed transport

scripts.generate: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml -p server --example export_openapi -- openapi.json && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/schema.d.ts
scripts.check:drift: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json src/schema.d.ts
